children: China video platform's Q3 revenue rose 8% yr/yr, driven by advertising growth
Adjusted net profit for Q3 rose 5% yr/yr
Company completed US$300 mln share repurchase, reducing share count by 4.9%
Company did not provide specific financial guidance for the current quarter or full year
ADVERTISING GROWTH - Co said advertising revenue rose 20% yr/yr, mainly due to improved product offerings and enhanced efficiency
VALUE-ADDED SERVICES - Revenue from value-added services rose 4% yr/yr, mainly due to increased premium memberships and other services
MONETIZATION EFFICIENCY - Gross profit rose as revenue growth outpaced cost increases, with co citing enhanced monetization efficiency
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "buy" and the breakdown of recommendations is 18 "strong buy" or "buy", 1 "hold" and no "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the online services peer group is "buy"
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for Bilibili Inc is HK$176.20, about 107.5% above its November 23 closing price of HK$84.90
The stock recently traded at 9 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 17 three months ago
